verify.description: Generate bindings and compare to existing file, error if different

lang.description: Language to output bindings in (c, C, c++, C++, cython, Cython)

package_version.description: Include the package version in the header comment

cpp_compat.description: Add C++ compatibility to generated C bindings

only_target_dependencies.description: Only fetch dependencies needed by the target platform

style.description: Declaration style: both, tag, or type

parse_dependencies.description: Whether to parse dependencies when generating bindings

clean.description: Use a new temporary directory for expanding macros

crate_name.description: Specific crate name to generate bindings for

output_path.description: File to output the bindings to

profile.description: Profile to use when expanding macros (Debug/Release)

depfile_path.description: Generate a depfile at this path

input_path.description: Crate directory or source file (typically where Cargo.toml resides)
